rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided Gardner 3BA label and notes expanded blastocyst/zona thinning, but the image is suboptimal and the response overstates confidence about clearly visualizing ICM, cohesive TE, and absence of debris/necrosis.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior live birth, endometrium, male factor context, and embryo grade into prognosis well, though some links are somewhat speculative.
Reasoning is structured and mostly internally consistent, with a plausible probability estimate tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor issues include unsupported quantitative adjustments.

Core recommendations such as SET and standard luteal support are guideline-concordant, but suggestions like routine aspirin, ERA after a single failure, IVM, and broad protocol changes/PGT-A in this young patient are not strongly guideline-based.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, but several recommendations are more speculative than standard-of-care and would need stronger case-specific justification.
